description: This Java class 'ModelKeyMap' models a key mapping element used in OFBiz entity framework, representing a mapping between fields of related entities, including constructors, XML serialization, and utility methods.

classes.name: ModelKeyMap
classes.description: An immutable class representing a key mapping between fields in entity models, supporting comparison, serialization, and XML conversion.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from field and related field names.

methods.name: ModelKeyMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing from an XML element, extracting attributes.

methods.name: getRelFieldName
methods.description: Returns the related entity field name.

methods.name: makeKeyMapList
methods.description: Factory methods to create lists of ModelKeyMap instances from provided field and relation names.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on fullName.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Creates an XML element representation of the key map.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this key map to another based on fullName for ordering.
